skins.name: Default

skins.name: Hand Drawn
skins.description: A sketchy, hand-drawn look: wobbly axis lines and jittery hand-drawn circles in dark grey, on a cool white background.

skins.name: Paper
skins.description: Flat black lines on an off-white background; bold, unlit flat colors on the data points.

skins.name: Sketchy
skins.description: Notebook yellow background, black flat lines and labels, nodes filled with their color and outlined in black like a doodle. Set nodes.useImages to true to show each node's thumbnail (when it has one) instead of a flat color fill.
